=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml:70-75 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The workflow steps do not map AI_MEMORY_SINGLE_BRANCH_CLONE_ENABLED into the environment, so a repository variable cannot reach the helper (reviewers cite lines 65-75, 70-75, and 71-75 and 203-208).
  WHY: The helper reads only os.environ and treats the variable as unset, so the clone path always stays on in this workflow. Severity differs by reviewer (NIT, BLOCKER, MAJOR); the highest, BLOCKER, is recorded here as critical.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "first clone only the memory branch: single-branch, with the branch option, no-tags, full history."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_memory_lib.py::_clone_for_memory_branch (fast path, lines 3252-3267)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The fast path still passes --depth 1 (lines 3255-3261), and tests/test_memory_maintenance_contract_noop.py:522-534 pins depth 1. The deviation is deliberate: it keeps behavior unchanged when the flag is unset and avoids the 260k-commit history fetch. Severity differs by reviewer (NIT to MAJOR).
- requirement: "Keep the explicit-refspec fetch and checkout."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_memory_lib.py::_clone_for_memory_branch, fast-path success branch (lines 3268-3270)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The fast-path success branch runs only checkout -B (line 3269). The explicit-refspec fetch exists only in _full_repo_clone_for_memory_branch (lines 3294-3296). The fetch is functionally redundant, since --single-branch --branch already creates the ref.
- requirement: expose the advertised AI_MEMORY_SINGLE_BRANCH_CLONE_ENABLED off switch so an operator can disable the single-branch clone from the memory-maintenance workflow without editing workflow code.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml "Extract repository learnings (fail-open)" env block (lines 71-75) and "Run memory compaction" env block (lines 203-208)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither env block passes the variable through, although the helper reads it at scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3213, and the agents.d fragment and changelog describe it as a user-facing off switch.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
